name: Story Lantern
tagline: A bedside lamp your kid talks to.
description: They ask for a story. Half a minute later a painted page appears in an open book and a warm voice starts reading one that has never existed before. Their characters come back next time looking and acting the same.

models.role: writes the story, and checks every page before a child hears it

asks_for.why: to ask your Tiiny for the story, the pictures and the voice
to reach the Tiiny on your own network
every story is kept with its pictures and narration so a child can hear it again

privacy.stores: Stories, illustrations, narration and a parent-readable log of every safety verdict. All of it on your own disk.
